author: Ava Cartes
title: Parents accused of fentanyl-related death of baby appear in court - NewsBreak
text:
By Ava Cartes ,
10 hours ago
SAVANNAH, Ga. (WSAV) — Two Chatham County parents made their first appearance in court Tuesday after the death of their nine-month-old daughter.
Heather Laborde, 36, and Paul Rapkin, 41, appeared in the Recorder’s Court for a felony docket tied to murder charges in connection to the death of their child.
The parents are accused of the November 2025 death of their infant, which investigators say was caused by the toxic effects of fentanyl and methamphetamine.
On Tuesday, police testified in the case, and it was determined there was enough information to move forward with a trial.
